rooms.description: Emergency lighting flickers red along a buckled corridor; the artificial gravity stutters.
A cracked viewport shows nothing but drifting debris and cold, unfamiliar stars.
The remains of a docking bay, an airlock frozen half-open.
A derelict cargo hold, crates torn open and scattered weightless in the dark.
The command ring hums faintly — some backup system refuses to die.
A viewing gallery, glass shattered outward into the void — something massive moves in the dark beyond it.
